name: Grand Theft Auto VI
summary: Grand Theft Auto VI is an open-world action-adventure game developed by Rockstar Games. Set in the fictional U.S. state of Leonida, which includes Vice City and its surrounding regions, the game follows Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, two criminals who become involved in a statewide conspiracy after a robbery goes wrong. Players can switch between the two protagonists while exploring the open world and completing story missions involving criminal activities, armed confrontations, and encounters with law enforcement. Gameplay combines driving, third-person combat, and exploration, plus optional activities like street racing, fishing, and other recreational pursuits.
